description: This file defines the class GoogleOAuthProviderConnector, which extends ExternalOAuthProviderConnector. It provides methods for configuring Google OAuth2 authentication, including URL generation, token mapping, and provider-specific parameters. The class customizes OAuth URL parameters and token handling for Google within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: GoogleOAuthProviderConnector
classes.description: A connector class that manages OAuth 2.0 authentication with Google, including URL configurations, token mapping, and URL cleanup for deprecated parameters.

methods.name: getExtraProviderParams
methods.description: Returns default OAuth parameters for Google, merged with parent settings.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Provides OAuth URL options, setting 'access_type' and 'prompt', removing deprecated 'approval_prompt'.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the OAuth access token to a structured array using token mapping, handling null tokens.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates and cleans up the OAuth authorization URL, removing deprecated parameters and ensuring correct URL parameters for Google OAuth.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Helper method to reconstruct a URL string from its parsed components.
